The two-step return is odd strictly decreasing, and its modulus f is continuous strictly increasing and sublinear at infinity; every amplitude orbit is eventually monotone and bounded. Substitution a=b+b³, t=b² gives exact residual -b H(t), H=t^4+3t³+3t²-nu*t-mu, with H strictly convex. Root counts and the unique fold tc follow from H′=0, muc=-3tc²(1+tc)². At positive roots 1-f′=2tH′/[(1+3t)(1+3a²)], determining stability and basins. Independent symbolic expansion verifies f(a)=a-3a^5+O(a^7) at mu=nu=0, yielding n a_n^4→1/12 by reciprocal difference; for mu=0,nu<0 the cubic term yields n a_n²→-1/(2nu). Endpoint mu=muc within mu>-1 is correctly conditioned.
